title: A Verified, Live Vehicle and the Rate a Restoration Charge Is Taken At
content:
A vehicle whose inspection record is current lowers the charge for restoring cover on its Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment, and whether its listing is live on the marketplace lowers it further.

- Where a passed inspection stands on the vehicle in the twelve months before and its listing is live on the marketplace, the charge is taken at the marketplace's verified-vehicle rate of 90 percent.
- Where a passed inspection stands in that period and the listing is not live, it is taken at the marketplace's unlisted-vehicle rate of 95 percent.
- Where no passed inspection stands in that period, no rate is applied on that account.

### Points of judgement

| Passed inspection in the twelve months before | Listing live | Charge taken at |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 90 percent |
| yes | no | 95 percent |
| no | either | the whole of the figure |

A vehicle with no passed inspection in the period carries the charge whole even where its listing is live.

### What the records show

The passed inspections on the vehicle and whether its listing is live are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle, a listing shown as listed being live and any other standing not.
